<p>Nghệ thuật không nhất thiết phải ở sa:
Art does not have to stay behind glass. It can live on the tote you take to the market, the mug beside your laptop or the notebook waiting for your next idea.

Start with what is around you

Look at the corner you use every day. A touch of cobalt, a loose brushstroke or the texture of natural canvas can be the beginning of your own colour story.

Choose something that makes you want to reach for it again.

Less, with a little more meaning

You do not need to replace everything. Try placing a small print beside a well-loved book. A thoughtful change can make a familiar space feel fresh.

<p>Print on Demand (POD) có nghĩa là in:
Print on demand means a design is printed onto a product after an order is placed. It connects the artwork, the product and the production partner in one made-to-order process.

Three steps to a first sample

Choose a blank product, prepare the artwork to the printer specifications, then order and inspect a physical sample before offering it for sale.

What a mockup cannot tell you

Screen colours can look different in print. Fabric, placement, dimensions and finish need to be checked on the actual product. A mockup helps you imagine the result, but does not replace a sample.

This FINNORA demo is not connected to an automated production or shipping service.
Một vài lưu ý trước khi giặt, cất giữ và: A few things to check before washing, storing and enjoying your printed everyday favourites.
<p>Mỗi chất liệu và kỹ thuật in có yêu c:
Different materials and printing methods need different care. Always follow the manufacturer instructions on the actual product.

For printed fabrics

Check the care label for washing temperatures and tumble-drying instructions. Avoid scrubbing or ironing directly over the print unless the manufacturer allows it.

For prints and everyday objects

Keep art prints away from moisture and prolonged direct sunlight. For mugs, check the specific guidance on dishwasher and microwave use.

These are illustrative care notes, not a replacement for your supplier instructions.
